title: Vitality KPI Sprint Planner
content:
Purpose:
This is an operational sprint planner for the ‘Vitality’ launch experiment (internal beta). Combines a compact KPI mosaic, week-by-week roadmap, and a lightweight go/no-go checklist with clear owners for rollforward actions. Intended as the single-page readout for launch ops and the first 72h staffing rota. Drafted as working doc — expects editing from eng, obs, and CS during preflight.

Scope and intended audience:
- Scope: Vitality feature (generation + reranking path). Focus on latency-sensitive flows and cost-per-call economics.
- Audience: product-ops, stability eng, serving/runtime, SRE, solutions eng, customer success.
- Not the canonical runbook for incidents — links to the incident playbook above. This is the operational plan for activation and immediate ramp.

Current quick status (snapshot):
- Internal beta scheduled: 2024-11-18 (canary) -> 2024-12-05 (wide beta).
- Readiness: 68% overall (see owner notes).
- Major open: dedicated KV-cache tuning on p99 paths, batching profile for short-seq traffic.
- Risk level: Medium-high for first 48h (latency volatility).

KPI mosaic (primary indicators - target / green thresh / escalation):
- End-to-end p50 latency (gen calls): 240ms / <= 300ms / > 500ms -> Escalate to serving-runtime oncall (Owen).
- End-to-end p95 latency (gen calls): 480ms / <= 600ms / > 900ms -> Immediate rollback trigger if sustained 30m+.
- SLO error rate (5xx + client-timeouts): 0.4% / <= 1.0% / > 2.5% -> Paging SRE (Ravi).
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $2.30 / <= $3.00 / > $4.00 -> Finance notification + throttle policy.
- Throughput (req/sec sustained): 120rps / >= 100rps / < 60rps -> Evaluate autoscale and burst pool.
- Customer NPS signal (beta users): baseline -> +5 within 30d; escalate if -10 delta.

Derived health gauges (secondary):
- KV cache hit ratio (prefix-heavy flows): target >= 78% (owner: Lena).
- Batch size distribution median: target 6 tokens / monitor drift to <3 or >25 (owner: Priya).
- Model fallback rate (auto-routing to smaller variant): <3% ideally; >10% indicates capacity starve.

Week-by-week sprint roadmap (compact):
- Week -3 (now -> 2024-10-26): Finalize metrics instrumentation + alert thresholds. Run smoke load tests with 10k synthetic users. Owners: Ava (product-ops), Owen (runtime).
- Week -2 (2024-10-27 -> 2024-11-02): KV/cache tuning sweep, quantization profile check, cost simulation. Owners: Lena + Applied-ML.
- Week -1 (2024-11-03 -> 2024-11-09): Canary config bake (routing rules, rate limits). Create canary traffic split and throttles. Owners: Platform eng + Product.
- Week 0 (2024-11-10 -> 2024-11-16): Dry-run: internal traffic ramp to 20% of expected beta, run 24h soak. Confirm p95 and SLOs.
- Launch window (canary -> 2024-11-18): Activate canary, monitor 0-72h closely. Escalation matrix live.
- Post-launch (2024-11-18 -> 2024-12-05): Phased widen to open beta; iteratively tune batching and cache.

Launch gate checklist (must be green or explicitly waived):
1) Metrics and dashboards in Console: token-level breakdown + p50/p95/p99 graphs present (owner: Ava) - status: green.
2) Alerting configured: latency SLO alert + error budget burn rate (owner: Ravi) - status: amber (thresholds drafted).
3) Rollback & fallback: automatic variant fallback + manual rollback steps documented (owner: Owen) - status: green.
4) Capacity reservation: burst pool reserved for week 0 (owner: Platform eng) - status: green.
5) Security & data flow: no PII exfil path; KMS keys validated (owner: Security) - status: green.
6) CS playbook ready: FAQ + escalation routing + support templates (owner: Priya) - status: amber (drafting FAQ).

Operational runbook snippets (quick actions):
- If p95 > 900ms for 30m: apply canary routing (route 80% to smaller model), notify oncall, enable additional GPU pool. Owner: Owen.
- If SLO error-rate > 2.5% for 15m: throttle new sessions to 10rps per user cohort, open incident channel, prepare rollback patch. Owner: Ravi.
- If cost per 1k tokens > $4: switch to reduced quantization profile or enable cache-only path for non-critical flows. Owner: Finance + Applied-ML.
content_addendum:
Notes to self / fragments:
- Confirm whether batcher exposes per-customer batching window (ask infra).
- Consider short-lived canary (3h cycles) vs continuous canary for noisy traffic.
- Need a smoke dataset that exercises long-context branching — current tests miss this.

Open questions for next review:
- Can we pre-warm KV caches for 10 VIP customers? (Lena to coordinate with infra).
- Is there a cost cap auto-trigger we can wire into the console for the first 72h? (Finance + Console eng).
- Which exact webhook will CS use for in-product bug reports? (Priya to confirm).

Risks & mitigations (short list):
- Risk: Latency spikes from cold LRU cache. Mitigation: pre-warm keys, raise cache retention for canary.
- Risk: Sudden cost blowout from regen loops. Mitigation: circuit breaker on per-user token spend and rate limit.
- Risk: Alert fatigue during early runs. Mitigation: staged alerting and oncall rotation with defined mute windows.

Staffing rota (first 72h):
- Day 0 lead: Ava (prod-ops)
- Serving runtime coverage: Owen (primary), + backup (TBD)
- SRE oncall: Ravi
- CS triage: Priya (first 24h) then handover
- Analytics & metric validation: Lena (first 36h)

Acceptance & signoff record (template):
- Product signoff: __________  Date: _____
- Runtime signoff: __________  Date: _____
- SRE signoff: __________  Date: _____

Next immediate steps (before next sync 2024-10-12):
- Owen: complete canary routing playbook and mock rollback (action by 2024-10-09).
- Lena: run KV cold-start perf matrix, share csv results (action by 2024-10-10).
- Priya: finalize CS FAQ + in-product report webhook (action by 2024-10-11).
- Ava: publish updated sprint plan + notify stakeholders (action by 2024-10-12).

References and shorthand used in doc:
- 'Gen calls' = full generation API flows including reranker step.
- 'KV' = prefix/key-value cache used by the runtime to speed autoregressive decode.
- Alert names: RED-GenLat-P95, RED-GenErr-Burn, RED-KV-Hit.

----
This is a working sheet: expect incremental edits and inline notes. If you copy to a canonical runbook, update the Confluence runbook link above.
